job_spec.purpose: ds-1010 2026-10-10: successor on main 83e0257a8: ot_link_credit keep only on l_valid / l_credit (the l_data keep made its hold-mux feedback tap the kept net, so io_flop_at_pins skipped 2,214 data pin flops: ct crpc elo_d TT -108 at the routed insertion). ct | ds-1010 2026-10-10: ct-split3crpb NEEDS_RTL TT -66.17 / FF -0.47 at the routed insertion (registers +82.7; only outputs): u_lo7 l_credit was merged by synthesis with an identical credit flop whose pin is on the E face, so the anchor put it there, 250 ps from lo7_r on the S face -> ot_link_credit pin registers (* keep *) (main 1f349bb9c). | ds-1010 2026-10-10 successor on main 64d47d89b: io_flop_at_pins nearest-die-edge fix (the old hook classified W/E-face pins as T on cores touching the die edge and stacked their flops on the top edge; cb crpa l_data[55] 170 um from its pin, TT -577). ct anchored (ct-split3cra TT -46.7 = input pin -> landing flop wire). | ds-1010 2026-10-10 dual track (ct-split3cra still routing, setup repair at eli_r[0] credit output): same CR RTL with every face pin flop anchored at its pin (io_flop_at_pins / out_flop_release, design standard). | redesign-ds 2026-10-10 split3 CR (credit seams): ct-split3a TT -168 and cb-split3a TT -232 (internals +200 / +26) were valid/ready skids at tile faces letting a pin (ready or valid) drive a 553-bit enable. CR: every lane and seam stream is a credit link (rtl/common/ot_link_credit.sv: pin flops both ways, credit pulses, 8-deep landing FIFO written without waiting for a pop (WFREE: consumer ready never reaches a 553-bit enable; ce pre-route -832 class), full rate) in cb / ce / ct and in the lane tile (LCR, same pins). +2..3 cycles per crossing each way. | redesign-ds 2026-10-10 ct-split3b (coordinator: do not wait for the re-judge): ct-split3a TT -168 / FF -2.6 with internals +200 = lane ready pin -> 553-bit relay load enables. LR=1: lane-facing sender with a registered lane ready (one-gate valid flop, beat presented only when the unchanged lane skid is provably empty; 1 beat per 2 cycles toward lanes 3/7) and lane-facing receiver with landing flops + 4-deep FIFO (full rate). | redesign-ds 2026-10-09 (coordinator: build the coll_core split now; the 540 x 1360.8 tile with 1,151 ps CTS insertion is the root problem): THREE-TILE collective core column (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/coll/dsfd_coll_split.sv, contract_split3, composition_split3.json): cb 680.4 x 340.2 (VM side + output queue + lanes 0/4 relays), ce 680.4 x 680.4 (engine + 24 FIFO SRAMs + queues + packer + lanes 1,2,5,6), ct 680.4 x 340.2 (lanes 3/7 relays); skid seams, credit-flow remote output queue (OQX), ck on the middle of a long face. Top tile, RVT.
